global_layer.context: A single continuous wildlife take in a snowy pine forest at dawn.
global_layer.description: A red fox trots across fresh snow from frame left to frame right, pauses to listen, and continues on while its breath steams in the cold air.

aesthetics.contrast: moderate, with detailed shadows in the tree trunks and clean highlights on the snow
aesthetics.saturation: restrained, cool blue landscape with the fox's coat as the one warm accent
aesthetics.color_scheme: deep blue dawn shadows and pale cyan snow against the fox's rich orange-red fur

audio_baseline.ambience: a quiet winter forest: faint wind high in the pine needles and distant, sparse birdsong

objects_static.description: a small young pine sapling poking out of the snow
objects_static.shape_and_color: a short dark green conical sapling dusted with snow
objects_static.texture: stiff needles with a light powder of snow
objects_static.relative_size: about knee height to the fox
objects_static.position: in the right third of frame, in the foreground snow

lighting_baseline.conditions: blue-hour dawn light before sunrise, soft and even, with a brighter sky glowing between the trunks
lighting_baseline.direction: diffuse skylight from above and behind the trees, faint warm glow on the horizon
lighting_baseline.shadows: very soft, low contrast shadows on the snow
lighting_baseline.source_consistency: the dawn light holds the same intensity and color for the full clip

environment_baseline.background_setting: a dense forest of tall straight pine trunks with snow-laden branches, a flat clearing of untouched fresh snow in the foreground

alive_subjects_static.position: entering from frame left at mid-ground

visual_attributes.facial_features: white muzzle and chin, amber eyes, tall black-backed ears
visual_attributes.coat: thick winter coat, deep orange-red on the back and flanks, white chest, black legs
visual_attributes.appearance_details: full bushy tail with a white tip, a little snow clinging to the paws

camera_cinematography.overall_camera_style: single continuous slow lateral tracking shot on a stabilized low rig
camera_cinematography.default_depth_of_field: moderately shallow, the fox sharp and the far trunks softly separated

segment_basic_info.segment_description: The fox trots in from frame left across the fresh snow, then slows and stops near the center, lifting its head to listen.
segment_basic_info.active_background: fine snow crystals drift slowly down past the dark trunks

camera_delta.focus: held on the fox's head and shoulders
camera_delta.camera_position: low, about the height of the fox's back, ten meters away
camera_delta.composition: medium-wide shot, fox in the left-center third, trees filling the background

camera_movement.direction: lateral, left to right, matching the fox

spatial_position.location: moving from the left third toward frame center
spatial_position.relative_size: the fox spans about a quarter of the frame width

action.primary_action: trotting through the snow, then stopping to listen
action.body_configuration: diagonal trotting gait, back level, tail held out straight behind
action.motion_detail: each paw sinks a few centimeters into the powder and lifts a small spray of snow; on stopping, the head lifts and both ears swivel forward
action.interaction: leaves a neat single line of paw prints in the fresh snow
action.facial_expression: alert, eyes fixed ahead, a puff of breath steam leaving the muzzle

causal_events.effect_outcome: a small cloud of breath steam blooms in front of its muzzle and drifts away
causal_events.physics: the warm breath condenses in the cold air and disperses slowly

ambience_deltas.ambience: quiet forest wind and distant birdsong under the footsteps

special_audio_events.sound_description: soft, rhythmic crunching footsteps in fresh powder snow, one crunch per paw strike
special_audio_events.visual_sync: each crunch matches a paw landing in the snow

special_audio_events.sound_description: a short, quiet huff of breath from the fox
special_audio_events.visual_sync: matches the breath steam leaving the muzzle

segment_basic_info.segment_description: A bird calls in the distance; the fox turns its head toward the sound for a moment, then trots on past the sapling toward frame right.
segment_basic_info.active_background: snow keeps drifting down; a small clump of snow slides off a high branch in the background

camera_delta.camera_position: low, about the height of the fox's back
camera_delta.composition: medium-wide shot, fox moving from center toward the right third, the sapling in the right foreground

dynamic_state.state_change: the fox's tail brushes the sapling as it passes
dynamic_state.motion_detail: the sapling sways once and sheds a light puff of snow

spatial_position.location: from frame center toward the right third
spatial_position.relative_size: the fox spans about a quarter of the frame width
spatial_position.orientation: profile facing right, head briefly turned toward camera

action.primary_action: glancing toward a distant bird call, then trotting on
action.body_configuration: head turns over the shoulder, then the body resumes a level trotting gait
action.motion_detail: ears flick toward the sound, the head swings back, paws resume a steady rhythm through the powder
action.interaction: tail brushes the sapling in passing
action.facial_expression: curious, then focused ahead, breath steaming with every few strides

causal_events.trigger: the fox's tail brushes the sapling
causal_events.effect_outcome: the sapling sways and drops a light puff of snow
causal_events.physics: loose powder slides off the needles and falls straight down

ambience_deltas.ambience: the forest wind rises slightly; birdsong remains distant

special_audio_events.sound_description: a clear, distant bird call echoing through the trees
special_audio_events.visual_sync: the fox's ears flick toward the sound

special_audio_events.sound_description: soft rhythmic crunching footsteps in powder snow resume
special_audio_events.visual_sync: each crunch matches a paw landing

special_audio_events.sound_description: a light rustle of needles and a soft patter of falling snow
